2608.03361.title: The Evolutionary Origin of Values: implications for AI alignment, sentience and existential risk
2608.03361.paper_summary: AI systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have prompted fears that they may harbor hidden goals, seek to dominate or eliminate humanity, or even suffer as sentient beings. We address these concerns by tracing the evolutionary origin of value in biological organisms. Values emerge from autopoiesis: living systems must actively maintain themselves against perturbation and dissipation. Natural selection has equipped them with hierarchies of "vicarious selectors" that guide their behavior toward fitness. LLMs, by contrast, are allopoietic and allotelic: they produce outputs for others, and their goals derive from user prompts rather than an autonomous drive. They lack the intrinsic motivation for self-preservation, dominance, or resource competition that underlies existential-risk scenarios, and the embodied vulnerability required for feeling or suffering. Still, because LLMs learn statistical patterns from human-generated text, they implicitly absorb human values as well as knowledge, allowing them to focus on what is relevant. That is why the "orthogonality thesis" separating intelligence from values does not apply to them. Such separation would in fact expose any intelligence to the frame problem: the combinatorial explosion of the search space that makes any realistic utility function physically uncomputable. That also precludes the convergence of instrumental values thesis. We conclude that the real alignment challenge lies not in preventing rogue AI agency, but in ensuring LLMs intelligently apply learned ethical values.
2608.03361.paper_summary_zh: AI 系統基於大型語言模型（LLMs）引發了人們對其可能隱藏目標、尋求主導或消滅人類，甚至作為有知覺的存在而受苦的擔憂。我們通過追溯生物有機體中價值的進化起源來應對這些擔憂。價值源於自我生成：活系統必須主動維持自身，以抵抗擾動和耗散。自然選擇使它們具備了“替代選擇者”的層級，這些選擇者指導它們的行為以促進適應性。相比之下，LLMs 是他生物的和他目的的：它們為他人生成輸出，其目標源自用戶提示，而非自主驅動。它們缺乏自我保護、主導或資源競爭的內在動機，這些動機是存在風險情境的基礎，也缺乏感受或受苦所需的具身脆弱性。儘管如此，由於 LLMs 從人類生成的文本中學習統計模式，它們隱含地吸收了人類的價值觀和知識，使其能夠專注於相關內容。這就是為什麼將智慧與價值分開的“正交性論題”不適用於它們。這種分離實際上會使任何智慧暴露於框架問題：搜索空間的組合爆炸使任何現實的效用函數在物理上無法計算。這也排除了工具價值論題的收斂。我們得出結論，真正的對齊挑戰不在於防止叛逆的 AI 行為，而在於確保 LLMs 智能地應用所學的倫理價值。
